about.description: Open-source MCP server for LinkedIn. Give Claude and any MCP-compatible AI agent access to profiles, companies, jobs, and messages.
about.head: 17be1db

name: v4.29.0
body:
## Highlights - **Stable error codes.** Failed calls name a code in `_meta` that clients can branch on. ([#1390](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1390) by @benjamin-di) - **Usage rules at connect.** Clients get the usage rules as MCP server instructions. ([#1402](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1402) by @mvanhorn) - **Crashed pages recover.** A crashed page is replaced instead of failing every later call. ([#1382](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1382) by @benjamin-di) ## Features - A failed tool call now says when LinkedIn answered HTTP 429 or 999 during it. ([#1264](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1264) by @shbernal) - MCPB bundle settings can point the server at your own Chrome or Chromium executable. ([#1303](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1303) by @kumiDa) - search_jobs reports why paging stopped, so a caller knows whether more results may exist. ([#1323](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1323) by @shbernal) - dismiss_job dismisses a job from job search so later searches no longer show it. ([#1326](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1326) by @shbernal) - New `get_easy_apply_form` tool reads an Easy Apply form's questions without answering. ([#1343](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1343) by @shbernal) - New `archive_conversation` tool archives a messaging thread by its id, InMail included. ([#1354](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1354) by @shbernal) - `get_person_profile` and `get_my_profile` can now read a profile's volunteering section. ([#1357](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1357) by @JaiPi) - search_posts can filter by content type, such as uploaded documents. ([#1377](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1377) by @sunnycho100) - Failed tool calls name a stable error code in `_meta`, beside the unchanged message. ([#1390](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1390) by @benjamin-di) - Add `get_session_status`, which reports the saved session without opening a browser. ([#1392](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1392) by @benjamin-di) - The server now sends its usage rules to MCP clients as server instructions. ([#1402](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1402) by @mvanhorn) - get_feed pairs a post's permalink with its text excerpt and URN when its markup has one. ([#1409](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1409) by @letya999) - Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac) in the Docker login viewer pastes plain text. ([#1414](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1414))
Bug Fixes (5) - search_people refuses a plain-text location and filters by a numeric geo URN id instead. ([#722](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/722) by @BasitS-hash) - search_jobs reports no_matching_jobs when LinkedIn's redesigned search matches nothing. ([#1363](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1363) by @shbernal) - A crashed browser page is now shut down and replaced instead of failing every later call. ([#1382](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1382) by @benjamin-di) - Raise fastmcp to 4.1.3, fixing the M2M OAuth advisory GHSA-vqqp-x5qm-5qp4. ([#1408](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1408) by @letya999) - Sidebar "Show all" links off LinkedIn are skipped, and diagnostics hide proxy credentials. ([#1417](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1417))
## Install or update > [!TIP] > New here? The [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server#readme) covers setup. ### Update with uvx Clients configured with `mcp-server-linkedin@latest` pick up v4.29.0 on their next start. To pin this release, use `mcp-server-linkedin@4.29.0` instead. ### Update with the MCP Bundle For Claude Desktop, download [linkedin-mcp-server-v4.29.0.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.29.0/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.29.0.mcpb) and open it to install or update. Bundles do not update themselves, so repeat this for every release. ### Update the Codex or Claude Code plugin Codex picks up v4.29.0 of the plugin in the background on its next start. In Claude Code, run this and restart: ```bash claude plugin update linkedin-mcp-server@linkedin-mcp-server ``` ### Update with Docker ```bash docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest ``` Use the `4.29.0` tag instead of `latest` to pin this release. --- **Contributors:** @benjamin-di (first contribution 🎉), @mvanhorn, @shbernal, @kumiDa (first contribution 🎉), @JaiPi (first contribution 🎉), @sunnycho100 (first contribution 🎉), @letya999 (first contribution 🎉), @BasitS-hash (first contribution 🎉), @stickerdaniel **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/compare/v4.28.0...v4.29.0
